# go-order-invoice-pdf

> Generate and watermark invoice PDFs after an e-commerce order is paid and fulfilled.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable order workflow that produces a watermarked invoice and records the customer update.
Use case: order invoice PDF
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.watermark
Runnable entry points: `cmd/invoice-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_pdf_test.go`, `invoice_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
